host.title: Host
host.description: IP address or hostname of the target HTTP Server.

port.title: Port
port.description: TCP port of the target HTTP Server.

uri.title: URI
uri.description: Optional HTTP URI for the target web server.

http_method.title: HTTP Method
http_method.description: HTTP method to use for requests.

proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.description: HTTP Proxy in format http://HOST:PORT. HTTPS not supported.

tls_ca_file.title: TLS CA File
tls_ca_file.description: Absolute path to CA certificate file.

tls_key_file.title: TLS Key File
tls_key_file.description: Absolute path to private key file.

tls_key_passwd.title: TLS Key Password
tls_key_passwd.description: Optional password for TLS private key file.

http_passwd.title: HTTP Password
http_passwd.description: Basic Auth password. Requires http_user to be set.

format.title: Format
format.description: Data format for the HTTP request body.

json_date_key.title: JSON Date Key
json_date_key.description: Name of the time key in the output record. Set to 'false' to disable.

header.title: Headers
header.description: HTTP header key/value pairs. Format: Key Value

header_tag.title: Header Tag
header_tag.description: Optional HTTP header field for the original message tag.

headers_key.title: Headers Key
headers_key.description: Key to use as headers (must prefix with $). The key must contain a map.

body_key.title: Body Key
body_key.description: Key to use as request body (must prefix with $). Must contain binary or raw string.

allow_duplicated_headers.title: Allow Duplicated Headers
allow_duplicated_headers.description: Allow duplicated headers. Latest key/value is preserved.

workers.title: Workers
workers.description: Number of workers to perform flush operations.

http_response_timeout.title: Response Timeout
http_response_timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for a server response.

http_read_idle_timeout.title: Read Idle Timeout
http_read_idle_timeout.description: Maximum time between consecutive reads. 0s uses io_timeout.

gelf_timestamp_key.title: GELF Timestamp Key
gelf_timestamp_key.description: Key for timestamp in GELF format.

gelf_host_key.title: GELF Host Key
gelf_host_key.description: Key for host in GELF format.

gelf_short_message_key.title: GELF Short Message Key
gelf_short_message_key.description: Key for short message in GELF format.

gelf_full_message_key.title: GELF Full Message Key
gelf_full_message_key.description: Key for full message in GELF format.

gelf_level_key.title: GELF Level Key
gelf_level_key.description: Key for level in GELF format.

aws_service.title: AWS Service
aws_service.description: AWS service code (e.g., es, xray) for SigV4 authentication.

aws_region.title: AWS Region
aws_region.description: AWS region of your service for SigV4 authentication.

aws_role_arn.title: AWS Role ARN
aws_role_arn.description: AWS IAM Role to assume for SigV4 authentication.

aws_external_id.title: AWS External ID
aws_external_id.description: External ID for the AWS IAM Role.

aws_sts_endpoint.title: AWS STS Endpoint
aws_sts_endpoint.description: Custom STS endpoint for STS API.
